## Setup

Import all necessary packages and functions.

```{r}
#| label: setup

library(tidyverse)
library(here)
source(here("Scripts/00_functions.R"))
```

## Data Import

Read in all presaved data.

```{r}
#| label: data import

documents_with_topics <- read_csv(here("Data/documents_with_topics.csv")) |>
  mutate(
    transcript_id = as.character(transcript_id),
    topic = as.character(topic)
  )
topic_info <- read_csv(here("Data/topic_info.csv")) |>
  rename(topic = Topic, topic_name = Name) |>
  mutate(topic = as.character(topic))
paragraphs_climate <- read_rds(here("Data/paragraphs_classified_wide_final.rds")) |> 
    filter(final_climate == TRUE)
```

## Visualization

Let's visualize the parties per topic.

```{r}
documents_with_topics_wide <- documents_with_topics |>
  left_join(topic_info, by = join_by(topic)) |>
  filter(topic != -1)

paragraphs_topics_wide <- documents_with_topics_wide |>
  inner_join(
    paragraphs_climate,
    by = join_by(transcript_id),
    relationship = "many-to-many"
  ) |>
  drop_na(ParlGroupAbbreviation)

# Define party order and colors (matching first plot)
party_names_order <- c(
  "Sozialdemokratische Fraktion",
  "Grüne Fraktion", 
  "Die Mitte-Fraktion / CVP-Fraktion",
  "Grünliberale Fraktion",
  "FDP-Liberale Fraktion",
  "Fraktion der Schweizerischen Volkspartei"
)

party_colors <- c(
  "Sozialdemokratische Fraktion" = "#E4032E",
  "Grüne Fraktion" = "#84B547",
  "Die Mitte-Fraktion / CVP-& BD-Fraktion" = "#FF8C00",
  "Grünliberale Fraktion" = "#650959ff",
  "FDP-Liberale Fraktion" = "#0571C1",
  "Fraktion der Schweizerischen Volkspartei" = "#00843D"
)

df_plot <- paragraphs_topics_wide |>
  filter(ParlGroupAbbreviation != "BD") |>
  mutate(
    ParlGroupName = case_when(
      ParlGroupAbbreviation == "M-E|BD" ~ "Die Mitte-Fraktion / CVP-& BD-Fraktion",
      .default = ParlGroupName
    )
  ) |>
  group_by(topic_name, ParlGroupName) |>
  summarise(
    group_count = n(),
    .groups = 'drop_last'
  ) |>
  mutate(
    pct_of_topic = group_count / sum(group_count),
    ParlGroupName = factor(ParlGroupName, levels = party_names_order)
  ) |>
  drop_na()

# Create plot with consistent colors and ordering
p <- ggplot(
  df_plot,
  aes(x = ParlGroupName, y = pct_of_topic, fill = ParlGroupName)
) +
  geom_col() +
  facet_wrap(vars(topic_name)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = party_colors) +
  labs(
    x = "Parliamentary Group",
    y = "Percentage of Speeches",
    title = "Speeches per Party and Topic",
    fill = "Party Name"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.text = element_text(size = 9),
    axis.text.x = element_blank()
  ) +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(nrow = 2))

ggsave(here("Outputs/13_plot_topic_party_distribution.png"))
write_rds(p, here("Outputs/13_plot_topic_party_distribution.rds"))

# show the plot
p
```

Let's answer the question how for each party the climate-related speeches are distributed across topics.

```{r}
# Get all unique topics and sort them alphabetically
topic_order <- paragraphs_topics_wide |>
  pull(topic_name) |>
  unique() |>
  sort()

df_plot_party_facet <- paragraphs_topics_wide |>
  mutate(
    ParlGroupName = case_when(
      ParlGroupAbbreviation %in% c("M-E", "BD") ~ "Die Mitte-Fraktion / CVP-& BD-Fraktion",
      .default = ParlGroupName
    ),
    topic_name = factor(topic_name, levels = topic_order)
  ) |>
  group_by(ParlGroupName, topic_name) |>
  arrange(ParlGroupName, topic_name) |>
  summarise(
    topic_count = n(),
    .groups = 'drop_last'
  ) |>
  mutate(
    pct_of_party = topic_count / sum(topic_count)
  ) |>
  drop_na()

p <- ggplot(
  df_plot_party_facet,
  aes(x = topic_name, y = pct_of_party, fill = topic_name)
) +
  geom_col() +
  facet_wrap(vars(ParlGroupName)) +
  labs(
    x = "Topic",
    y = "Share (%)",
    title = "Topic Distribution within Each Party",
    fill = "Topic"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.text = element_text(size = 8),
    axis.text.x = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.x = element_blank()
  ) +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(nrow = 5))

ggsave(here("Outputs/13_plot_topic_distribution_by_party.png"), width = 12, height = 8)
write_rds(p, here("Outputs/13_plot_topic_distribution_by_party.rds"))

# show the plot
p
```
